'''October 2000 Glenside tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Glenside, PA on 29 October 2000. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1398">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-glenside-pa-10-29-2000d1398/ glenside-pa-10-29-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-glenside-pa-10-29-2000d1398/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Glenside, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
